messages.text: HI,I HAVE A FEW QUESTIONS PLZ
Sure, fire away. The NerdQX is $299.99, 8 TH/s, 145 W at the wall — about $10 a month in power at 10¢. What do you want to know first?
ARE THERE ANY VIDEO REVIEWS PHERHAPS ON YT?

I can't link you a specific one from here — I'd be guessing, and I won't do that. Searching "NerdQX" or "NerdQaxe" on YouTube turns up teardowns and setup clips from the Bitaxe crowd, which is the same family of board.

Anything specific you're trying to judge from a video — noise, or the setup?
AND I'M IN THE UK. ANY ESTIMATE ON IMPORT DUTY, IF AT ALL?

Yes — UK orders can be charged VAT and import duty on delivery, and that's the recipient's side. We don't collect it at checkout, so the $299.99 is the unit price only.

The standard UK VAT rate is 20%, applied by the carrier on the value plus shipping; duty varies and I can't quote what HMRC will raise. Shipping to the UK starts at $30.99, shown at checkout.
OK THANKS
Used the chat-interview skill
Before you go, one thing: what's holding you back on the NerdQX?
UNSEEN  COSTS LIKE VAT...

Fair. Rough landed: $299.99 plus about $31 shipping is ~$331, and 20% VAT on that is about $66 — call it $400 all in, plus whatever duty the carrier adds.

Does a number like that change it for you, or is it the not-knowing that stops you?
WELL FOR  THE MOMENT,DONT I NEED A POWER CONVERTER?
Read the nerdqx 8th s page
Searched the catalog · NerdQX 8TH/s

No converter. It comes with the power supply and you pick the UK AC cable at checkout — the UK variant is the one in stock, so that's what you'd get.

Want me to build that cart so you can see the shipping line?
OH OK GREAT IS THERE ANYTHING ELSE I NOTICED  OVERCLOCK KIT?

Honestly, skip it. It's a $59.99 power-supply adapter, not a service, and overclocking voids the warranty — the NerdQX runs fine stock at 8 TH/s on 145 W.

The unit and the UK cable are all you need. Shall I put the cart together?
OK GREAT
